baseline_models.focus_anchor: The genitive construction لِيَوْمِ ٱلْفَصْلِ joins يَوْم to the judgment branch of ف ص ل.
baseline_models.mechanism: A neutral date is intensified into a weighty event-occasion whose defining operation is a ruling that decisively distinguishes opposed claims or conditions.

activation_trace.role: The severe event-day image makes يَوْم a consequential occurrence rather than a neutral calendar unit.
The judgment image supplies decisive adjudication as the event's defining operation.

changed_reading.after: For the severe occasion constituted by a decisive judgment that distinguishes what had remained contested.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فَصْلِ can name the act of separating things until the limit between them becomes visible.
baseline_models.mechanism: The phrase marks an interval whose function is not merely to announce difference but to produce a perceptible boundary by cutting apart what was joined or confused.

activation_trace.role: The open span-of-time image lets the named day function as a bounded phase rather than only daylight hours.
The basic separation image supplies cutting apart and making the intervening limit visible.

changed_reading.before: A time at which already distinct groups are named.
changed_reading.after: A time that actively makes the boundary visible by separating what was previously contiguous or confounded.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ف ص ل inventory links separation with an articulating tongue and with detailing parts and meanings.
baseline_models.mechanism: Difference can be produced epistemically: the occasion separates by articulating and detailing matters until their internal parts and meanings become explicit.

activation_trace.role: The major-occasion image gives the act of clarification event-scale force.
The articulating-tongue image makes distinct expression one possible mode of separation.
The detailing image turns separation into clarification through the exposure of parts and meanings.

changed_reading.before: Separation as only physical or social division.
changed_reading.after: An occasion of articulated disclosure in which distinctions become undeniable because matters are set out part by part.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The open temporal range of يَوْم combines with the joint-between-parts branch of ف ص ل.
baseline_models.mechanism: The phrase can image a hinge in time: a bounded occasion that both joins two phases and prevents them from remaining one continuous condition.

activation_trace.role: The variable-duration image allows يَوْم to denote a phase boundary rather than a solar day.
The joint image supplies a hinge that connects adjacent parts while marking their limit.

changed_reading.before: A date located within an unchanged temporal continuum.
changed_reading.after: The temporal joint at which one condition ends and another becomes articulated from it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The offspring-weaned-from-mother branch remains directly attached to فَصْلِ, though it is form-distant from judicial usage.
baseline_models.mechanism: Separation may be modeled as forced maturity or loss of sustaining attachment: the event ends a dependent condition and exposes the separated party to an independent state.

activation_trace.role: The severe-occasion image gives dependency severance the force of a consequential transition.
The weaning image supplies separation from a sustaining source as the transition mechanism.

changed_reading.before: A judgment that classifies subjects from outside.
changed_reading.after: A severe transition that severs prior dependency and makes each subject stand in a newly independent condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence releases in succession, drives forcefully, spreads out, differentiates, and casts a reminder. Against that ordered sequence, فَصْل becomes the culminating operation of a sorting process that first mobilizes and exposes material before drawing its decisive boundary.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch anchors the model in separation that visibly establishes a boundary.
Succession with segmentation supplies the first ordered movement in the proposed sorting sequence.
The violent wind image supplies force that loosens and scatters what had held together.
Opening, spreading, and branching supply spatial exposure of the material to be distinguished.
Explicit differentiation supplies the immediate sorting operation that anticipates فَصْل.
Casting supplies the directed delivery by which the sequence reaches an addressee.
The reminder image makes disclosure and response part of what the sorting process exposes.

structural_cues: 77:1-5 presents a tightly ordered chain of marked actions rather than an isolated noun list.
The explicit differentiation in 77:4 precedes the focus phrase and gives فَصْل a processual precursor.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies succession, forceful scattering, spreading, differentiation, casting, and reminder in sequence; I supply the arrow that treats them as stages culminating in فَصْل, while the live alternative is that they are parallel oath images rather than one pipeline.

changed_reading.before: A static court date at which a distinction is simply announced.
changed_reading.after: The culmination of a mobilizing and exposing process that makes decisive sorting possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Promise is bounded by appointment, then described as falling into actuality; messengers are timed and postponement reaches a fixed limit. The focus day is therefore the temporal hinge at which an announced future ceases to be deferred and becomes an occurrence.

activation_trace.role: The focus span-of-time branch anchors the mechanism in a temporally bounded phase.
The joint image supplies the threshold where deferred and actual phases meet and separate.
The appointment image makes the promise explicitly bounded by a time or place.
The non-dominant counted-time branch adds an exploratory image of an interval whose recurrence or count runs to completion.
Falling and becoming fixed supplies the transition from promised status into realized occurrence.
Limitation by a time or endpoint makes scheduling an active constraint in the sequence.
The interrogated temporal span creates the slot answered by the focus phrase.
The fixed terminal limit turns postponement into a bounded delay rather than indefinite absence.

structural_cues: 77:7 asserts that what is promised will occur, while 77:11-12 moves through timing and postponement to the answer in 77:13.
The initial لِـ in 77:13 directly answers the preceding question about the day for which the event was deferred.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies appointment, occurrence, timing, postponement, and a fixed temporal limit; I infer the directional crossing from deferred promise to realized event at the focus joint, while a live alternative is that these are compatible temporal labels without a staged transition.

changed_reading.before: A remote future date described only by what happens there.
changed_reading.after: The fixed hinge at which a timed promise exhausts its delay and becomes an established occurrence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Visible celestial markers are erased, the overhead expanse is opened, and raised solid masses are removed from place. فَصْل consequently does not merely preserve familiar divisions; it names decisive reclassification after the world's old coordinates and barriers have been undone.

activation_trace.role: The focus separation image anchors the model in the production of a newly visible limit.
The visible rising-marker image supplies a familiar coordinate that can then be erased.
Erasing and wiping out a trace removes an old means of distinction.
The elevated covering expanse supplies the large-scale boundary subjected to opening.
The opening of a gap between things converts a continuous cover into an exposed interval.
The raised solid mass supplies an apparently stable terrestrial divider.
Uprooting and removal from place strip that stable divider from the landscape.

structural_cues: 77:8-10 repeats the same conditional onset across three transformations immediately before the timing question in 77:12.
The sequence targets light-bearing, overhead, and terrestrial orientation markers in turn.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies erased traces, an opened expanse, and uprooted solid masses; I infer that undoing inherited boundaries prepares a new decisive classification, while a live alternative is that the transformations only signal severity and do not explain فَصْل's operation.

changed_reading.before: Separation sorts entities inside a stable and already mapped order.
changed_reading.after: Separation reconstitutes decisive boundaries after the old markers by which reality was organized have collapsed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The severe event-day is repeatedly paired with those who deny, and the recurring warning divides the surah into successive evidentiary units. The focus phrase therefore names the event while also functioning as a compositional key for the text's repeated separators.

activation_trace.role: The formal textual-separator image anchors the compositional reading directly in فَصْل.
The reiterated severe event-day image carries the focus label into the refrain system.
Attribution of denial supplies the recurring addressee category around which each textual unit closes.

structural_cues: The warning formula recurs at 77:15, 19, 24, 28, 34, 37, 40, 45, 47, and 49.
Those recurrences follow distinct scenes and make visible boundaries between the surah's argument units.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated day-and-denial formula at regular scene boundaries; I infer that the repetitions enact the formal-separator branch of ف ص ل, while a live alternative is that repetition only intensifies warning and carries no compositional semantics.

changed_reading.before: The phrase only refers outward to a future event.
changed_reading.after: The phrase also provides the organizing principle enacted by the text as repeated refrains separate and accumulate its evidentiary scenes.

context_deltas.mechanism: Generative fluid is held in a stable place until a measured bound, and the earth is then imaged as a vessel gathering living and dead. These nested containment scenes activate فَصْل as severance from a sustaining enclosure when its limit is reached, extending judgment into a lifecycle transition.

activation_trace.role: The weaning image anchors the model in separation from a sustaining origin after dependence.
The temporal-span image lets the event mark the completion of a bounded developmental interval.
The reproductive-fluid image supplies the material initially dependent on enclosure.
Fixity and stability supply the holding condition before release.
The place-of-being image turns containment into a located and enabling environment.
A measure reaching its limit supplies the threshold at which containment can end.
Gathering and holding in a vessel repeats the enclosure mechanism at terrestrial scale.
The living-being image supplies one class held by the earth-container.
Loss of life supplies the contrasting class held within the same encompassing vessel.

structural_cues: 77:20-23 moves from generative material through secure placement to a known measure.
77:25-26 repeats containment at earth scale and places living and dead side by side within it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reproductive material, stable placement, a measured limit, and an earth-vessel holding living and dead; I infer a repeated containment-to-release pattern that activates the weaning branch, while a live alternative is that the scenes independently demonstrate ordering without implying release at 77:13.

changed_reading.before: A verdict imposed on already independent subjects.
changed_reading.after: A terminal transition in which bounded forms of dependence and containment reach their limit and their occupants are made separately answerable.

context_deltas.mechanism: One group is released toward a three-branched shade that neither shades nor suffices against flame, whereas the protected occupy effective shades. The focus separation becomes a functional assay of boundaries: formal partition is exposed as useless unless it actually wards harm.

activation_trace.role: The short defensive-wall image anchors the reading in a separator evaluated as a protective barrier.
Unrestrained departure supplies movement into the destination whose protection will be tested.
The shelter-and-protection image states the expected function that the following negation withdraws.
Branching and dispersal supply a visibly partitioned form that may still fail to protect.
Sufficiency supplies the practical criterion explicitly denied to the false shade.
The tongue-of-fire image supplies the harm that penetrates the failed barrier.
Warding off harm supplies the defining capacity of the contrasting protected group.
The repeated shelter image now retains its protective function, completing the contrast with false shade.

structural_cues: 77:30-31 names a branched shade and then immediately negates both shade and sufficiency.
77:41 reuses the shade image for those defined by warding harm, creating a functional rather than merely visual contrast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visually branched shade that fails and protective shade that succeeds; I infer that the contrast tests separators by their capacity to ward harm, while a live alternative is that the two shade scenes only mark destinations and do not redefine فَصْل.

changed_reading.before: Separation as the mere placement of groups on different sides of a boundary.
changed_reading.after: Separation as exposure of whether a claimed boundary actually protects, distinguishing formal partition from effective refuge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus inventory allows separation by articulating and detailing, but the context removes speech, permission, and apology from the judged. The decisive distinction is therefore not negotiated through their explanatory discourse; it is disclosed under a procedural asymmetry in which their capacity to reframe the case is suspended.

activation_trace.role: The articulating-tongue image anchors the revised model in one potential mode of making distinctions.
The judgment image preserves adjudication when the parties' own articulation is withdrawn.
Literal speech supplies the capacity explicitly negated on this day.
Permission supplies the procedural gate that remains closed.
Excuse and apology supply the defensive speech act prevented by the closed gate.

structural_cues: 77:35-36 uses consecutive negations: they do not speak, permission is not given, and apology therefore does not occur.
The explicit day formula in 77:35 reconnects the speech suspension to the focus occasion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies absent speech, withheld permission, and blocked apology; I infer that this procedural asymmetry prevents self-authored reclassification and leaves decisive disclosure to the event, while a live alternative is that silence is only an outcome of judgment rather than part of its mechanism.

changed_reading.before: A day on which competing accounts are verbally articulated until truth is separated from falsehood.
changed_reading.after: A day whose decisive articulation proceeds without the judged being permitted to repair their position through speech or excuse.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated label يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ is immediately followed by gathering the present addressees with the former ones. Separation therefore operates through prior co-presence: dispersed temporal cohorts are first brought into one comparative field and only then decisively distinguished.

activation_trace.role: The focus separation image anchors the operation in making a decisive boundary visible.
The repeated judgment branch explicitly restates the focus event at the point where its procedure is expanded.
Gathering dispersed elements into one whole supplies the prerequisite common field for comparison.
Beginning and precedence extend the assembly across temporal cohorts to those who came before.

structural_cues: 77:38 places the repeated focus phrase and the gathering clause in the same ayah.
The coordinated objects join the current addressees with former ones before any further challenge is issued.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit gathering of current and former cohorts immediately after the focus label; I infer a procedural arrow from assembly to comparative separation, while a live alternative is that gathering merely locates everyone present and is not logically prior to sorting.

changed_reading.before: Separation as scattering groups farther apart.
changed_reading.after: A decisive distinction produced after otherwise dispersed generations are assembled into one field where their differences can be exposed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Those who ward harm receive an environment linked to their work and recompense, while the criminal addressees are assigned only slight, time-limited benefit. Separation is thus enacted as differentiated affordance and duration, not left as an abstract verdict.

activation_trace.role: The focus judgment branch anchors differentiated outcomes in decisive adjudication.
Warding harm supplies the defining condition of the protected outcome class.
Intentional work supplies the stated basis to which the favorable allocation is linked.
Reciprocating an act with its due consequence supplies the allocation rule.
Enjoyable utility supplies the contrasting benefit granted to the other class.
Smallness and paucity sharply limit that contrasting benefit's extent.
The offense image identifies the condition attached to the restricted allocation.

structural_cues: 77:41-44 gives protection, consumption, work, and recompense as one sequence.
77:46 mirrors the consumption command but limits enjoyment and closes by naming the addressees as offenders.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two allocation scenes, one linked to work and recompense and the other explicitly limited and linked to offense; I infer that فَصْل is realized through differential access and duration, while a live alternative is that the scenes illustrate results without describing the separating operation itself.

changed_reading.before: A binary label assigned at judgment with no specified material effect.
changed_reading.after: A judgment enacted through sharply different environments, access, and temporal horizons according to what each class has done.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries the anatomical-joint branch into a commanded posture; it remains anchored in فَصْل B005 and the literal bending language of 77:48, but downstream prose should present it only as an embodied analogy, not as an etymological claim that ٱلْفَصْل means bowing.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The joint-between-parts branch of ف ص ل can make bodily articulation a concrete image of whether a subject yields at a separating threshold.

activation_trace.role: The bodily-joint image anchors the cross-domain move in an attested focus branch.
Spoken utterance supplies the command that calls for an embodied response.
Bending and lowering the head supply the literal bodily articulation that is refused.

changed_reading.before: The event separates by an external pronouncement alone.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the event also exposes separation through bodily articulation: the command reaches the joints, and refusal to bend makes non-yielding visible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it renders judgment as terrain and flow; it remains anchored in the topographic channel branch of فَصْل and in packet images of opened gaps, removed and stable mountains, and routed sweet water, but downstream prose should qualify it as a spatial mechanism rather than a replacement lexical sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ف ص ل B006 images a gap or channel between mountain or sand formations through which water can pass.

activation_trace.role: The mountain-or-sand channel image anchors the reading in a spatial focus branch.
An opened gap supplies the first channel-forming spatial operation.
The raised solid mass supplies the terrain whose limits ordinarily route movement.
Removal from place supplies the reconfiguration of that routing terrain.
Fixity and rootedness supply the contrasting stable mountain condition.
A share and course of irrigation supplies directed flow through the configured terrain.
Sweet water supplies the beneficial material whose route depends on channels and barriers.

changed_reading.before: Separation as a purely abstract classification.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, a terrain-changing event that removes old barriers and forms channels through which distinct courses and destinations become possible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant ج ز ي mapping to a cutting-at-ripeness branch; it remains anchored in the cutting sense of فَصْل, the event-time sense of يَوْم, and the packet's fruit and recompense sequence, but downstream prose must label it a split-root harvest analogy rather than a reading of نَجْزِى by that branch.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The event-day and basic cutting branches can jointly image a threshold at which matured produce is severed and allocated.

activation_trace.role: The consequential event-time image supplies a moment of ripened transition.
The basic cutting-apart image supplies the harvest-like severing operation.
Pleasant fruit supplies the produce image that makes a harvest analogy materially visible.
The non-dominant time-of-cutting-at-ripeness branch supplies the exploratory harvest threshold tied to recompense.

changed_reading.before: A verdict unrelated to maturation or the production that precedes it.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the ripe threshold at which what has grown is cut free and its resulting share is allocated.

strongest_changes: The focus moved from a static court date to the culmination of an ordered process of release, exposure, differentiation, and reminder.
Timing cues made the day a hinge where bounded postponement becomes fixed occurrence.
Cosmic boundary collapse and the explicit gathering in 77:38 made separation a reclassification performed after old coordinates fail and dispersed cohorts are assembled.
Later contrasts made the judgment operational through speech control, effective versus failed protection, and differentiated access and duration.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet let the two-word focus phrase activate across distant scales without losing its anchors: formal refrain, temporal scheduling, cosmic remapping, lifecycle containment, procedural silence, shelter, bodily joints, terrain channels, and an explicitly contained split-root harvest image.
remaining_uncertainties: The opening actions may be parallel oath images rather than causal stages in one sorting process.
The formal-divider reading may describe the surah's composition without contributing to the phrase's event semantics.
The containment, joint, channel, and harvest readings are branch-backed analogies, but their directional relation to the focus remains exploratory.
Speech suspension may be a consequence of decisive judgment rather than a mechanism by which distinction is produced.
